headline: LIFE PRISONER CONVICTED OF BRUTAL INMATE ATTACK AT SALINAS VALLEY STATE PRISON
summary: Monterey County District Attorney Jeannine M. Pacioni announced today that Ray Gutierrez Jr. was convicted by a jury of assault by a life prisoner and personal infliction of great bodily injury.
